title: FIELD SKETCH - blind-g-lounge
anchor: pen 15'-11" lounge width (top chain total and bottom wall agree)
interpretations: The top-wall pen chain reads 10" + 13'-11" + 12" = 15'-11", but the parts sum to 15'-9" (189"), 2" short of the stated 15'-11" (191") total. This is the plan's own arithmetic, transcribed as written; the checker will fail the chain by name, which is correct — either the clear-between-heaters figure is really 14'-1", or the total is really 15'-9". The independent bottom-wall dimension of 15'-11" corroborates the total, so the middle (clear) figure is the suspect, but nobody has measured it: Gabe must resolve before build.

Starred note on the plan: 'middle figure is clear btwn the heaters' — so 13'-11" is the clear width between the two heaters, NOT a wall or room dimension. It is recorded only inside the chain parts, never as a run value.
Room taken as a plain rectangle 15'-11" (E-W) x 10'-5" (N-S): left and right walls are both dimensioned 10'-5", top and bottom both 15'-11". Plan top treated as model North.

The break in the drawn east wall (between the 3'-5" point and the lower wall segment) is read as the DR 3'-0" door opening, with the short horizontal line at its upper jamb read as the door leaf drawn swung ~90 degrees into the room. The gap and leaf both scale to roughly 36", consistent with DR 3'-0".

The 3'-5" dimension on the right edge runs from the NE corner down to the door's near jamb, so door at = 3'-5" from the NE corner (start of the east run). Hinge at that near jamb (leaf drawn attached there), so hinge = near.
Door height is not on the plan; h is omitted so it builds 80" flagged DEFAULT per the schema.

Heaters: HTR 10" (NW end of north wall) and HTR 12" (NE end) are drawn as dashed boxes flush to their corners, and the chain 10" + clear + 12" spans the full north wall, so both are placed flush: left heater from = 0". Right heater from = 14'-11" (stated 15'-11" total minus its 12" length); note that the chain-sum reading would instead give 14'-9" — same 2" discrepancy as above.
Heater depth (off-wall) is not dimensioned anywhere; recorded as assumed 8", scaled roughly from the dashed outlines against the 15'-11" wall — needs a tape measurement.
Ceiling CLG 8'-5" is stated in pen; taken as the room ceiling height.
Wall thickness and sill are not on the plan; omitted so house defaults (4" / 48") apply. No windows or bulkheads are drawn.
